title: NeverHit
features:
NeverHit is an open source project and work in progress script that uses a custom loader to support multiple HVH games. It includes a built-in executor checker and a clean interface. Since it is in early development, new features are being added frequently.
Penablox HVH Features
Custom Divine resolver for hitting desync and jitter. Force hit using event hooks with auto hit positioning. Advanced anti aim with 5-way, jitter, and pitch modes. Spread modifiers, infinite ammo, and hitbox extenders. Automatic client anticheat bypass for movement and part checks.
Europhium HVH Features
Force hit using event hook methods to redirect shots. No spread exploit using math random hooking for perfect accuracy. Customizable hit parts including head and torso.
Sultanisimus HVH Features
Fast kill all exploit that targets every player in the lobby. Auto heal which teleports healing parts directly to your character.
General Features
Fatality UI with a smooth loader. Support for custom chat prefixes and colors. Built-in rejoin on kick system. Compatibility checker to ensure your executor supports the required functions.
This is a community project and the source code is available on GitHub. Join our discord for support and to follow the development progress.
